//exclude: Edge code is Deno (remote URL imports, .ts extensions, Deno globals) and tsc cannot resolve it — `deno check` is its ONLY typecheck. But excluding the whole tree made a shared type between server and client physically impossible, which is why the response envelope has a hand-written second copy in chat.service.ts and drifted (plan v2, F0 · B0). The exclusion is therefore narrowed to everything EXCEPT shared/contracts/, which holds TYPE-ONLY declarations with zero imports so both runtimes can read it. seam-check enforces that purity.
